defaults._levelCapWhenNeedsReview_rationale: Site-wide: downgrade axe 'incomplete' (needsFurtherReview) color-contrast entries to notice-level. This only affects results axe itself flags as uncertain — a hard, confidently-detected contrast violation still reports as a normal error and fails the run. Confirmed false-positive patterns across this site: (1) form inputs next to a notecard texture webp/SVG ornament — imgNode/pseudoContent incomplete entries, real contrast 8.8:1 and 4.55:1 (guestbook); (2) a lone leading glyph (e.g. '→') as a paragraph's first text node — axe's 'nonBmp' non-text-content heuristic can't resolve which run to sample, real contrast ~13:1 (project pages); (3) citation links wrapped in <em> inside the desktop footnote sidebar — real contrast ~12.9:1 (writings with footnotes). All verified directly via axe.run() outside pa11y-ci.
